title: Smoky French Lentil Hash
description: A hearty French-inspired lentil dish with a smoky twist, served as a side or light meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the diced smoked bacon and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the red lentils, thyme, and garlic to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the hash browns to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Cook the lentils separately according to package instructions.
Combine cooked lentils with the skillet mixture and stir to combine.
